name: Artifact
text: Negates the next debuff.

name: Block
text: Until next turn, prevents damage.

name: Burn
text: Burns are unplayable status cards that damage you.

name: Calm
text: Upon exiting this Stance, gain 2 Energy.

name: Channel
text: Channeling an Orb puts it into your first empty slot. If you have no empty slots, your first Orb is automatically Evoked to make room.

name: Confused
text: Whenever you draw a card, randomize its cost.

name: Curse
text: Curse cards are negative cards that stay in your deck.

name: Dark
text: Orb: Increases damage every turn. When Evoked, deals damage to the enemy with the least HP.

name: Dazed
text: Dazed are unplayable status cards.

name: Dexterity
text: Dexterity improves Block gained from cards.

name: Divinity
text: Upon entering this stance, gain 3 Energy. Attacks deal triple damage. Exit this Stance at the start of your next turn.

name: Ethereal
text: If this card is in your hand at the end of turn, it is exhausted. Exhausted cards are removed from your deck until the end of combat.

name: Evoke
text: Consume your rightmost Orb and use its Evoke effect.

name: Exhaust
text: Removed until end of combat.

name: Fatal
text: Triggers whenever this card kills a non-minion enemy.

name: Focus
text: Focus increases the effectiveness of Channeled Orbs.

name: Frail
text: While Frail, gain 25% less Block from cards.

name: Frost
text: Orb: Gains Block.

name: Innate
text: Start each combat with this card in your hand.

name: Intangible
text: Reduce ALL damage taken and HP loss to 1.

name: Lightning
text: Orb: Deals damage to random enemies.

name: Lock-On
text: Lock-On targets receive 50% more damage from Orbs.

name: Plasma
text: Orb: Gains Energy.

name: Poison
text: Poisoned creatures lose HP at the start of their turn. Each turn, Poison is reduced by 1.

name: Mantra
text: When you obtain 10 Mantra, enter Divinity.

name: Regen
text: Regen heals HP at the end of your turn. Each turn, Regen is reduced by 1.

name: Retain
text: Retained cards are not discarded at the end of turn.

name: Ritual
text: Gain Strength at the end of your turn.

name: Scry
text: Look at the top X cards of your draw pile. You may discard any of them.

name: Shiv
text: Shivs are 0 cost Attack cards which Exhaust.

name: Stance
text: You can only have one stance at a time.

name: Status
text: Status cards are removed at the end of combat.

name: Strength
text: Strength adds additional damage to attacks.

name: Thorns
text: When receiving Attack damage, deals damage back.

name: Transform
text: Transformed cards become a random card of any rarity.

name: Unplayable
text: Unplayable cards cannot be played from your hand.

name: Upgrade
text: Upgrading cards makes them more powerful. Cards can only be upgraded once.

name: Void
text: Voids are unplayable status cards that consume energy when drawn.

name: Vulnerable
text: Vulnerable creatures take 50% more damage from Attacks.

name: Weak
text: Weakened creatures deal 25% less damage with Attacks.

name: Wound
text: Wounds are unplayable status cards.

name: Wrath
text: In this Stance, you deal and receive double attack damage.

name: Hex
text: Whenever you play a non-Attack card, shuffle X Dazed into your draw pile.

name: Mark
text: Whenever you play Pressure Points, loses X HP.

name: Plated Armor
text: At the end of your turn, gain X Block. Receiving unblocked attack damage reduces Plated Armor by 1.

name: Stasis
text: On death, is returned to your hand.

name: Surrounded
text: Receive 50% more damage if attacked from behind. Use targeting cards or potions to change your orientation.
